title: SensorInput
description: Disaster sensor report POSTed to the Go supervisor (POST /sensor, Content-Type: application/json). Every field is required and unknown fields are rejected (422 validation_failed). Schema-valid input can still be refused at runtime: a disaster_type that GET /capabilities does not report as "operational" gets 422 "unsupported: not implemented by this supervisor". See docs/README.md for the full response table.

event_id.description: Unique disaster event identifier, 1..64 characters: a letter or digit followed by letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Reusing an id with a different payload is refused (409 event_id_conflict).

disaster_type.description: Type of disaster detected. Only types that GET /capabilities reports as "operational" are accepted (today: earthquake); flood and heatwave are rejected with 422 "unsupported: not implemented by this supervisor".

radius_km.description: Estimated affected radius in kilometres (> 0, <= 500). Zones are bands of this radius.

depth_km.description: Earthquake depth in km, 0..800 (0 for non-seismic disasters)

tsunami_risk.description: Whether coastal tsunami risk is present (earthquake only)
